title: 2 TUBS OF REFERENCE BOOKS
reason: Under-described book lot: a few mid-value titles (Hofmann monograph, Miro, Made in Czechoslovakia, Hallmarks of Antique Glass, convict listings) among mostly ordinary books.
findings: Two tubs of roughly 80 to 100 books, mostly paperbacks and hardbacks on glass, art, trains and Australian local history. Titles read from spines and covers: Hans Hofmann (large yellow jacket, introductory essay by Sam Hunter; the signature-style lettering on the spine is printed, not a handwritten inscription); Miro by Juan Perucho (large illustrated monograph); Made in Czechoslovakia by Ruth A. Forsythe; The Hallmarks of Antique Glass by R. Wilkinson (jacketed); Glass by George Savage; Bristol by John Bedford; How to Restore & Repair Practically Everything; Steam Trains (Nelson Colour Library); Gregory's Fishing Guide; The Painted Stream (Robin Armstrong); Ciruelo Cabral; Superpen (Edward Sorel); Colours of Australia; 50 Years Sweden Australia New Zealand; This Other Eden; The Third Fleet Convicts; The Second Fleet Convicts; Legend Walk; Magpie Fly Over (history of Bonnie Doon Golf Club 1897-1997, Rick Martin and Peter Hicks); Aboriginal Words and Place Names (A.W. Reed); The Edwardian House; South Barwon 1837-1965; The Early Settlement of South Gippsland. No signed copies or dedications seen. The title gives no hint of the art monographs or the glass references.
condition: Jackets on the large art books look intact in the photos; tub books show ordinary shelf wear; inside condition not visible.
rescore_note: Two tubs of roughly 80 to 100 mostly ordinary books with a few useful titles (Hans Hofmann monograph whose spine signature is printed, Miro by Perucho, Forsythe Made in Czechoslovakia, Hallmarks of Antique Glass, Second and Third Fleet convict listings) and no signed copies seen; bulk art and reference book lots usually sell cheaply, my estimate about $40 to $80, no comps found (web search budget was used up).
